Tara S.: heads up — ran into a weird auth + export shape issue when building the JS SDK for edge with esbuild via vite.
Tara S.: repo: https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-esbuild-edge-auth2 (private)
Noah P.: quick summary?
Tara S.: build ESM -> all good. build CJS (vite lib formats:['cjs'] or esbuild format:'cjs') -> deployed to edge -> requests return 401 and we see `TypeError: sdk.generate is not a function`.
Eunice: sounds like default vs named export interop. Which package entrypoints point where?
Tara S.: package.json has "main" -> dist/cjs/index.js and "module" -> dist/esm/index.js. Edge deploy resolver picks CJS entry and esbuild output wraps exports differently.
Noah P.: repro steps?
Tara S.: 1) git clone ...repro-esbuild-edge-auth2 2) npm i 3) npm run build:cjs 4) deno task start:edge 5) curl the gen endpoint with Authorization header -> 401 + TypeError.
Eunice: vite config snippet that triggers it:
```js
build: { lib: { entry: 'src/index.ts', formats: ['cjs'] }, commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true } }
```
Marta: workaround?
Tara S.: force ESM output or add a small runtime interop wrapper at package root: `module.exports = exports.default ? exports.default : exports` — fixes runtime but ugly. Also add docs warning for sample apps.
Dev CI: I added a smoke CI job to the repro that builds both formats and runs an edge emulation — artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/repro/ci/
Noah P.: action items: (1) patch SDK entry to normalize exports (Ben will PR), (2) update onboarding sample app to default to ESM, (3) add CI edge-smoke into SDK pipeline.
Tara S.: opening PR with repro + failing job now. ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:
